notes: v0.14: Longer days and nights (8 min, a bit more day than night) and faster, nastier Mire stalkers. The Warden now leads one station at a time (+20% or more there), fights with a staff, levels up, wears a cloak, casts spells (Magic 2+), and is needed for more puzzles. New planning station by the lore table: scholars sketch, gather and shape parts; builders finish (spears, axes, bridge, torch posts, nets, cauldron, quarry wheel). The bridge needs two Skilled Builders and a Skilled Scholar together. Chapter 1 Reconstruction: rebuild the lab, guard tower and lovers' tent, plus a house. Herbs grow wild; children and foragers bring them to the lab (tap it for storage). New potions: Quickstep, Spark of Mastery, Deep Breath, Heartroot, Moonfire, Mirebane. Funerals on the west beach and candles on the sea for the dead. Pop-up notices pause the game; random decisions with 3-5 choices. Move houses, larder and tent. Lagoon grove needs Food 2, honey Food 2 + Lore 2. Foragers move between food they know. Up to 3 raids while away. Bare village centre, relocated tower and spring.
